scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.db:deploy:vercel: npm exec -w backend -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma-postgres/schema.prisma && npm exec -w backend -- prisma generate --schema prisma-postgres/schema.prisma && npm run db:categories -w backend
